frozen_AS_witness.structure: 1120 width-4 XOR clauses plus one width-5 non-affine defect clause

frozen_hypothesis: CNF formulas that decompose into an exactly recognized affine/XOR core A plus at most D_MAX non-affine defect clauses admit a proof-carrying polynomial decision door by enumerating one satisfied literal per defect clause and solving the resulting affine systems over GF(2).

affine_extraction: Canonicalize clauses and group by unsigned variable support.
A support-group of width k is an affine parity block iff it contains exactly 2^(k-1) distinct clauses and all clause sign-bit vectors have the same parity; no truth oracle may be used.
Each recognized group contributes one GF(2) parity equation; every unrecognized clause is a defect clause.
Extraction must replay every recognized parity block back to exactly the source clause set before the block may be removed from the defect set.
bounded_defect_door: Require defect_count <= D_MAX; otherwise return DEFECT_BOUND_EXCEEDED, not a scientific counterexample to SAT in P.
For d defect clauses D1..Dd enumerate the Cartesian product D1 x ... x Dd, choosing one literal per defect clause to assert true.
For each tuple, add the selected literal assignments as GF(2) unit equations to affine core A and run deterministic Gaussian elimination over GF(2).
If any branch is consistent, reconstruct a full variable assignment, verify it against the original CNF independently, and return SAT with certificate.
If every branch is inconsistent, retain per-branch row-reduction contradiction certificates and return UNSAT for the bounded-defect formula.

complexity_ledger.GF2_solve_per_branch: polynomial in explicit affine matrix dimensions

non_falsifying_boundary: DEFECT_BOUND_EXCEEDED means AT scope exhausted; it is not a solver counterexample and not a P-vs-NP result.
truth_oracle_policy: No SAT truth oracle may choose extraction, branches, literals, equations, or candidates. Independent full-CNF validation is allowed only after the algorithm has produced a candidate model; tiny synthetic controls may have preregistered expected labels.
success_condition: Exact AS residual and all frozen bounded-defect controls pass extraction/replay, deterministic GF(2) branch solving, certificate verification, and independent reconstruction validation with no falsifier.
scientific_scope_if_success: A polynomial alternative door is established only for exactly recognized affine-core plus <=4 defect-clause formulas. Universal arbitrary-CNF coverage remains OPEN.
